notes: 'over against' is one compound English preposition for 'ad + nokhach, headed on the governing opening morpheme (rules 23, 30); neither English word can be assigned to one preposition non-arbitrarily.
Both prepositional predicates ('there were with him', 'was with him') take their copulas on the preposition under rule 49, and the waw of s025 takes the postposed 'also' under rule 51.
